Call useOptimistic(value, reducer) to provide immediate UI feedback during asynchronous Actions. It provides a temporary state that is applied instantly but is automatically discarded and reverted to the true underlying value once the pending Transition or Action completes, eliminating the need to manually implement error recovery or state rollback logic.

Developers can use navigator.locks.request() to acquire exclusive or shared locks asynchronously, enabling safe coordination of shared resources across multiple tabs or workers within the same origin.
Apply autocomplete="one-time-code" to verification inputs so browsers like Safari (14+) can parse SMS codes and suggest them directly on the user's virtual keyboard.

The View Transition API drastically simplifies complex transition logic by taking visual snapshots of old and new DOM states and automatically animating between them, rather than requiring manual loading and repositioning logic via CSS/JS.

topic: CSS Container Queries with JS Fallback
technical_takeaway: Enable container queries natively by setting `container-type: inline-size` on parent elements. For unsupported older browsers, implement a custom `<responsive-container>` web component that uses a ResizeObserver to manually trigger scoped breakpoint classes, avoiding the performance penalty of a full CSS polyfill.
